children: HDFC Bank Limited Sponsored ADR (NSE:HDFCBANK) reported September-quarter standalone net profit of Rs.19,509.96 crore, up nearly 5% year over year, while net interest income rose 9.72% to Rs.34,619.18 crore.
Previous Week Recap
Quarterly Profit And NII Growth
: HDFC Bank reported September-quarter standalone net profit of Rs.19,509.96 crore, up nearly 5% year over year. Net interest income rose 9.72% to Rs.34,619.18 crore; margin was 3.16% of assets.
Governance Concerns Ease; Leadership Shift
: HDFCBANK shares recovered as governance concerns eased after part-time Chairman Atanu Chakraborty resigned. Anup Bagchi is set to replace CEO Sashidhar Jagdishan, whose term ends October 26.
Merger Pressures Weigh On Shares
: HDFCBANK shares lagged the Nifty 50 over the past year amid slower growth and margin pressures tied to the HDFC Ltd merger. The bank is addressing merger-related funding challenges.
MCLR Rates Rise Across Tenures
: HDFC Bank Sponsored ADR (HDFCBANK) raised MCLR rates by 5–15 basis points across all seven tenures, effective Nov. 7, 2026. New rates range from 7.85% to 8.70%.
Board Approves Rangan Reappointment
: HDFC Bank’s board approved V. Srinivasa Rangan’s one-year reappointment as executive director from Nov. 23, 2026, at current pay, subject to shareholder approval.
Foreign Overweight Position Narrows
: Jefferies said foreign investors’ relative overweight in HDFC Bank Limited Sponsored ADR (HDFCBANK) versus the MSCI India index declined by 2.4 percentage points to 1%.
Choksey Names Preferred Lender
: Deven Choksey named HDFC Bank his preferred private-sector lender, citing upside potential and lower downside risk than some peers. He said corrective steps could unlock value.
Shares Trade In Tight Range
: HDFCBANK is trading in a near-term Rs.780–820 range, with support at Rs.780 and resistance at Rs.820. A decisive close above Rs.820 would signal a breakout.
Axis Direct Names Preferred Bank
: Axis Direct analyst Hemang Gor named HDFC Bank Limited Sponsored ADR (HDFCBANK) a preferred bank stock, citing earnings visibility across the sector and positive technical indicators.
